body:
## Pull request overview

This PR expands the ObjectStack CLI with a set of remote-first commands that talk to a running ObjectStack server over the REST APIs, including auth, data CRUD/query, and metadata management, plus shared CLI utilities and tests.

**Changes:**
- Added 12 new remote API CLI commands under `auth`, `data`, and `meta` topics.
- Introduced shared utilities for API client creation, credential storage, and output formatting (json/table/yaml).
- Added documentation, unit tests for command conventions/utilities, and updated CLI dependencies + changelog.

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 20 out of 21 changed files in this pull request and generated 19 comments.

<details>
<summary>Show a summary per file</summary>

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| REMOTE_API_COMMANDS.md | End-user documentation for remote API CLI workflows and examples. |
| packages/cli/src/utils/api-client.ts | Creates `@objectstack/client` instances and enforces auth presence. |
| packages/cli/src/utils/auth-config.ts | Reads/writes/deletes `~/.objectstack/credentials.json`. |
| packages/cli/src/utils/output-formatter.ts | Implements `json` / `yaml` / `table` output formatting. |
| packages/cli/src/commands/auth/login.ts | Adds interactive/non-interactive login and credential persistence. |
| packages/cli/src/commands/auth/logout.ts | Clears stored credentials. |
| packages/cli/src/commands/auth/whoami.ts | Calls session endpoint and prints current user/session info. |
| packages/cli/src/commands/data/query.ts | Queries records with filter/fields/sort/limit/offset and formatting. |
| packages/cli/src/commands/data/get.ts | Fetches a single record by ID with formatting. |
| packages/cli/src/commands/data/create.ts | Creates a record from JSON arg or JSON file. |
| packages/cli/src/commands/data/update.ts | Partially updates a record from JSON arg or JSON file. |
| packages/cli/src/commands/data/delete.ts | Deletes a record with json/table output. |
| packages/cli/src/commands/meta/list.ts | Lists metadata types or items with json/table/yaml output. |
| packages/cli/src/commands/meta/get.ts | Fetches a metadata item with json/table/yaml output. |
| packages/cli/src/commands/meta/register.ts | Registers metadata from a JSON file (PUT). |
| packages/cli/src/commands/meta/delete.ts | Deletes metadata (currently via direct fetch). |
| packages/cli/test/remote-api-utils.test.ts | Unit tests for api-client/auth-config/output formatter utilities. |
| packages/cli/test/remote-api-commands.test.ts | Convention/shape tests for the new oclif commands. |
| packages/cli/package.json | Adds workspace dependency on `@objectstack/client` and `yaml`. |
| CHANGELOG.md | Documents the new remote API commands and their flags/formats. |
</details>

## Unused variable, import, function or class

Unused import AuthConfig.

[Show more details](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/framework/security/code-scanning/507)
This module imports `AuthConfig` but never uses it. Removing the unused import avoids lint noise and keeps the file focused.

Many commands call `requireAuth((client as any).token)` because ObjectStackClient.token is a private field. This couples the CLI to internal `@objectstack/client` implementation details and may break on refactors. A more robust approach is to have createApiClient() return the resolved token (or expose a public getter on the client) so requireAuth can validate without `as any` casts.

writeAuthConfig() writes with `{ mode: 0o600 }`, but if the credentials file already exists, Node won’t necessarily update permissions. That can leave credentials readable if the file previously had broader perms. Consider explicitly chmod’ing to 0600 after write (best-effort, platform-aware) to enforce the security guarantee.

Interactive password input is echoed to the terminal (`readline.question('Password: ')`). This exposes passwords in terminal scrollback/screen recordings and is generally unsafe for an auth command. Consider switching to a prompt implementation that supports masked/hidden input (or implement hidden input with readline keypress handling).

`Args` is imported but unused in this command. Removing unused imports helps keep eslint clean and avoids accidental drift.
